about: Reviewed golf data for Okanagan Roam golf-course pages. Every green fee is copied from the course's official website (source_url) on the date shown; nothing is estimated. The comparison rate is each course's standard adult rate for its standard round (9 or 18 holes), at prime time in peak season, as published. Course maps are links to the club's own pages only (rights_status link_only); nothing is copied or hosted.
